description: public.png from the macOS general pasteboard
how: Opened /private/tmp/rclip-capture/bands.png (24x16 truecolour PNG, three vertical colour bands, written by hand with zlib), then Edit > Select All, Edit > Copy.
notes: Preview re-encodes rather than copying the file's bytes: the 93-byte source PNG comes back as 200 bytes with sRGB and eXIf chunks added.
